about_the_game:
"BlueLine" is a thought-provoking visual narrative experience exploring the quest for happiness in the digital age. Step into the shoes of Blue, a Bangkok millennial grappling with the pressures of social media and the struggle to stay true to oneself. Perfect for those seeking a meaningful, story-rich and introspective gaming experience.

Deep, Story-Rich Experience

  • A slow-burning narrative with rising tension across multiple chapters.

  • Themes of self-worth, inner conflict, and the courage to reach out in a relatable way.

Pressure & Emotional Struggle

  • Witness Blue’s spiral as he deals with external expectations and internal conflict.

  • A thought-provoking portrayal of mental health and personal growth.

Complex Characters & Relationships

  • Interact with characters who have conflicting desires, pulling Blue in different directions.

  • Maintain relationships through conversations, trips, and meaningful interactions.

Relatable Life Experiences

  • Experience the pressures of modern life—social media, expectations, and self-doubt.

  • Scrolling feeds, overthinking, and navigating relationships

Striking Visual & Cinematic Style

  • Hand-drawn animatic scenes bring emotional moments to life.

  • Framing, color, and camera movement used to enhance mood and storytelling.

  • Beautifully crafted scenery: fireworks, clouds, flower fields, and more.

Authentic Thai Setting

  • Explore Thailand’s culture, landscapes, and daily life through Blue’s eyes.

  • Experience family dynamics and love as part of the narrative.

Atmospheric Soundtrack

  • A peaceful, immersive score that complements the introspective tone.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 980
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: A visual narrative experience about a Bangkok millennial, Blue, balancing authenticity and social media pressures in a digital age. Engage in mindful activities, engaging conversations, as well as navigate the tension between authenticity and the need to impress.
